=='''Overview'''==
'''Kazoru''' is a {{Rarity|Legendary}} unit. He is only obtainable through [[Summon|summons]].
He is also the boss of stage 4 of [[Story#Marine's Ford|Marine's Ford]] as The Yellow Monkey, though his name in the stage is "Light Admiral".
